# PeakVisor

> > PeakVisor is a comprehensive mountain identification and outdoor navigation platform providing 3D maps, elevation data, peak information, and hiking trail details for mountain ranges worldwide.

PeakVisor catalogs thousands of mountain ranges, peaks, and hiking areas across continents, offering detailed topographic information, prominence data, and interactive 3D mapping tools for hikers, skiers, and outdoor enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- 3D mountain maps
- Peak identification and prominence
- Elevation data and topography
- Hiking trails and outdoor navigation
- Mountain ranges worldwide
- Skiing areas and winter sports
- Topographic mapping
- Peak lists and summit information
- Hiking areas and trail guides
- Mountain prominence calculations
- GPS navigation for mountains
- Alpine and volcanic ranges
- Outdoor recreation planning

## Major Mountain Ranges - North America

- [San Francisco Peaks](https://peakvisor.com/range/san-francisco-peaks.html): Arizona volcanic range near Flagstaff, home to Humphrey's Peak
- [Absaroka Range](https://peakvisor.com/range/absaroka-range.html): Montana-Wyoming range with 399 peaks including Francs Peak
- [Chuska Mountains](https://peakvisor.com/range/chuska-mountains.html): 60-mile range in New Mexico/Arizona within Navajo Nation, 151 peaks
- [Sheep Range](https://peakvisor.com/range/sheep-range.html): Nevada mountain range stretching 56 miles north of Las Vegas
- [Fish Lake Plateau](https://peakvisor.com/range/fish-lake-plateau.html): Plateau with 70 peaks, Mount Marvine is the highest
- [Galiuro Mountains](https://peakvisor.com/range/galiuro-mountains.html): Arizona range with 21 peaks, Bassett Peak is the highest
- [Hitt Mountains](https://peakvisor.com/range/hitt-mountains.html): Idaho range near Oregon border with 13 peaks, topped by Sturgill Peak

## European Alpine Ranges

- [Texel Group](https://peakvisor.com/range/texel-group.html): Alpine range with 71 peaks including Roteck, the highest mountain
- [Goldberg Group](https://peakvisor.com/range/goldberg-group.html): Austrian Alps range with 300 peaks, Hocharn is the highest
- [Hochkalter](https://peakvisor.com/range/hochkalter.html): Alpine range with 45 peaks including namesake Hochkalter summit

## International Mountain Ranges

- [Queen Elizabeth Islands](https://peakvisor.com/range/queen-elizabeth-islands.html): Arctic archipelago spanning Nunavut and Northwest Territories, Canada
- [Akan Volcanic Complex](https://peakvisor.com/range/akan-volcanic-complex.html): Hokkaido volcanic complex with 50 peaks, highest is Meakan Dake
- [Ahaggar Mountains](https://peakvisor.com/range/ahaggar-mountains.html): North African range with 515 peaks, Tahat is the highest
- [North Baikal Range](https://peakvisor.com/range/north-baikal-range.html): Russian range with 79 peaks, Pik Baikal is the highest

## Regional and Lesser-Known Ranges

- [Bilk Creek Mountains](https://peakvisor.com/range/bilk-creek-mountains.html): Range with 15 peaks, highest being Engeler Peak
- [Tetrahedron Plateau](https://peakvisor.com/range/tetrahedron-plateau.html): Plateau with 13 peaks topped by Tetrahedron Peak
- [Halfprint Range](https://peakvisor.com/range/halfprint-range.html): Range with 11 peaks, Cockeyed Ridge is the highest
- [Virginia Mountains](https://peakvisor.com/range/virginia-mountains.html): Small range with 7 peaks topped by Tule Peak
- [Seaman Range](https://peakvisor.com/range/seaman-range.html): Small range with 3 peaks including Black Cliff, the highest
- [East Parhoc Range](https://peakvisor.com/range/east-parhoc-range.html): Small range with single named peak, Medsger Pass
